en.title: Tiles, colour mixing, see-through 3D things and drags in the checker
en.body: What the round-6 games still wrote by hand. `game.tiles(rows, { size, x, y, colors, solid })` makes a level of tiles from rows of characters, as one sprite, with `pushOut` out of its solid tiles, `solidAt`, `at` and `set`. `game.mix(a, b, t)` mixes two colours. A `play3d` thing takes `opacity`: see-through things cast no shadow, and one that also glows adds its light to what is behind it, as a beam. A menu title of several lines gets as many lines of room. `tools/verify-game.mjs` drags twice in its blind play, and a play script has `player.drag`. `llms.txt` and the play guides say how a 3D thing turns and which way it faces, that every shape is placed by its middle, that `.loop()` repeats for ever and that defining a sound again replaces it.

zh.title: 瓦片、颜色混合、半透明 3D 物体，验证器支持拖拽
zh.body: 第 6 轮游戏里还要手写的东西都补上了。`game.tiles(rows, { size, x, y, colors, solid })` 用几行字符生成瓦片关卡，画成一个精灵，提供 `pushOut`（移出实心瓦片）、`solidAt`、`at` 和 `set`。`game.mix(a, b, t)` 混合两种颜色。`play3d` 物体支持 `opacity`：半透明物体不投影，同时发光时光会叠加到后面，可以做光束。多行菜单标题会留出相应的行高。`tools/verify-game.mjs` 的盲玩加入两次拖拽，试玩脚本新增 `player.drag`。`llms.txt` 和 play 指南写明了 3D 物体的旋转方向与朝向、所有形状以中心定位、`.loop()` 不带参数会无限重复，以及重新定义同名音效会替换它。
